description: Upload a photo of your room to start the AI analysis and get your redesign in 30 seconds.Shopia turns a photo of your room into a photo-realistic redesign in just a few minutes. Upload your space, pick a vibe from 70+ styles (Scandinavian, Japandi, Bohemian, Industrial, Minimalist and more), and get an AI-generated makeover rendered at the exact scale of your room, furniture included.
